profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary:
I enjoy building, maintaining and optimizing computer systems:
- distributed systems
- high performance systems
- storage systems
- scheduling systems
- configuration systems

Usually these tasks fall under Software Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, etc. 👍
